independence: Same original continuous RHS, event cells, kernel and tau coordinates; a separately pinned Rust integration method. Different methods and local error estimators do not imply identical accepted trajectories.

solver_diagnostics.accepted_grid_encoding: C-contiguous little-endian float64 x values, including the initial point and every accepted endpoint
solver_diagnostics.counter_note: nfev=Rust RHS RPC requests; njev=Python Jacobian RPC requests; nlu=Vigilode direct_factorizations attempts or Diffsol number_of_linear_solver_setups, not identical work definitions; actual original RHS count includes explicit gas/time FD; raw Rust counters retained. C21I original_rhs_requests includes internal derivative requests; original_rhs_cache_hits are successful-value reuses; original_rhs_evaluations and reference rhs_evaluations count actual underlying calls, including failed attempts. Native counters remain provider-owned actual calls.

tolerance_contract.endpoint_sampling_policy: The provider epoch, opacity and H use xx=min(max(x,lo+1e-9*(hi-lo)),hi-1e-9*(hi-lo)) in each event interval; the state and integration grid retain x
tolerance_contract.note: tau absolute tolerance is dimensionless, not equal to absolute photon count tolerance
tolerance_contract.interpretation: requested local integration-error scales in the listed coordinates, not a bound on global state or photon errors

fixed_diagonal_scaling.definition: tau/fraction:1; number ledger:1 per H; thermal:w0; energy ledger:w0+initial binding+all fixed birth photon energy

tolerance_contract.partial_t_policy: Original cell-clamped RHS: zero flat branches, zero branch convention at clamp corners, represented-node FD strictly inside; no cross-cell samples.
tolerance_contract.jacobian_policy: Analytic tau columns, exactly zero 15 passive-ledger columns, admissible represented-node quadratic FD for gas columns.

raw_result.accepted_grid_origin: direct Diffsol state after each successful step call
raw_result.h_max_policy: rolling hard-stop cap, independent of output grid
raw_result.initial_step_policy: explicit h0 through public new_without_initialise; no out-of-segment estimate probe
raw_result.jacobian_policy: parent full Jacobian; exact (t,y) bit cache for JVP
raw_result.max_steps_semantics: outer accepted-step calls; internal retries in solver counters
raw_result.output_policy: BDF interpolation of accepted intervals; exact final stop
